additional_info.subject: ID0443368/DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / P3 170000420]Charger in failure after rest CRM:02681000618
additional_info.body:
Hello Julian, good afternoon. I hope you are doing well.
I found the root cause which is a communication drop between the charging station and the charging controller.
I will install a hotfix that strenghtens the communication between them and the outlets shouldn't have this problem anymore. If, after the update, the error reoccurs, we need to troubleshoot it in order to confirm what is the problem in a new ticket.
The hotfix takes 10mins to install and since no one is using the charging station now, I will do it now. Afterwards, I will close the ticket.
Thank you and have a nice week ahead.
Best regards,
Francisco
